Counting distinguished cyclic one positions by stars-and-bars and correcting overlap yields the binomial formula; the block generating functions B=z^3/(1-z)^2 and C=z^2/(1-z) give the stated log-derivative series, with reciprocal roots establishing lambda and phi coefficients. Distinct rotations are indexed rather than necklace-equivalent; n=1,2 and zero output follow from the local rule. Independent forward enumeration checked all 8190 length-n binary words for n<=12 against classifier and formula; finite enumeration supports, but does not replace, the all-n proof.
